item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00175","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C23","C10","C09"],"selected_candidate_label":"C23","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C23 supplies a concrete, material template for the child: the same comprehensive enumeration of tax returns, inspection during the Eighty-second Congress by a congressional committee or authorized subcommittee, an inquiry-specific purpose clause, incorporation of conditions in a contemporaneously approved Treasury decision, and the identical Federal Register effectiveness clause. The child adapts this machinery to the House Judiciary Committee, extends the covered period through 1951, and adds a requirement for a written statement supporting each requested return. C10 and C09 use the same overall inspection-order framework, but C23 is materially closer in both wording and structure.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"any income, excess-profits, declared value excess-profits, capital stock, estate or gift tax return for any period to and including 1951","parent_excerpt":"any income, excess-profits, declared value excess-profits, capital stock, estate, or gift tax return for any period to and including 1950","explanation":"Nearly verbatim enumeration and temporal formulation, with only the terminal year changed."},{"child_excerpt":"shall, during the Eighty-second Congress, be open to inspection by the Committee on the Judiciary, House of Representatives, or any duly authorized subcommittee thereof","parent_excerpt":"shall, during the Eighty-second Congress, be open to Inspection by the Senate Committee on Rules and Administration or any duly authorized subcommittee thereof","explanation":"The same congressional-duration and committee/subcommittee inspection mechanism is adapted to a different chamber and committee."},{"child_excerpt":"subject to the conditions stated in the Treasury decision relating to the inspection of such returns by that Committee, approved by me this date","parent_excerpt":"subject to the conditions stated in the Treasury decision relating to the Inspection of such returns by that committee, approved by me this date","explanation":"Essentially identical incorporation of the accompanying Treasury decision."},{"child_excerpt":"This Executive order shall be effective upon its filing for publication in the Federal Register.","parent_excerpt":"This Executive order shall be effective upon its filing for publication in the Federal Register.","explanation":"Identical effectiveness provision, reinforcing the broader clause-by-clause correspondence."}]}
